pages.text: Pylons move energy in and out of the core. Place a pylon, then put any glass block on the side that faces the core; the glass turns into the pylon's sphere. The core has to be roughly within 18 blocks on that side.$(br2)$(l)Shift-right-click$() the pylon to draw a line to its core, or to cycle between cores in range. Pylons do nothing while the core is inactive.

pages.title: Input or output
pages.text: Right-click the sphere to switch modes. The action bar tells you which one you picked:$(li)$(2)INPUT$(): charges the core from whatever feeds the pylon. Green sides.$(li)$(c)OUTPUT$(): drains the core into the blocks around the pylon, including cables. Red sides.$(br2)Stained glass colours the pylon's particles. A comparator next to a pylon reads how full the core is.
